environment: macOS, Node.js 22.22.2, isolated ARKA_NORN_HOME directories, loopback HTTP servers and isolated npm consumer
scope: Managed Web server lifecycle, process ownership, private state, CLI localization, documentation, release packaging and workflow regressions.
prerequisites: development-report-norn-project-web-002 is schema-valid and selected as the latest development report.
The production package was rebuilt after moving the process manager into the composition layer.

test_cases.name: Managed background lifecycle
steps: Start Norn Web on a free loopback port.
Read status and probe authenticated health.
Restart without changing the requested port.
test_cases.expected_outcome: The server runs detached, restart rotates PID and token, and stop is idempotent.
test_cases.actual_result: The dedicated E2E passed all lifecycle assertions in 4.2 seconds.

test_cases.name: Private state and verified process ownership
steps: Persist and reload a valid server state.
Reject malformed tokens and non-loopback URLs.
Attempt removal from a different PID.
test_cases.expected_outcome: State is mode 0600, invalid state is rejected and only the owner removes it.
test_cases.actual_result: All filesystem state tests passed; the manager probes authenticated health before signalling a PID.

test_cases.name: CLI contracts and documentation
steps: Exercise stopped status in human and JSON output.
Reject invalid actions, ports and option combinations.
Compare README, CLI and Web guides with package scripts.
test_cases.expected_outcome: The five lifecycle actions are stable, localized and consistently documented.
test_cases.actual_result: 112 unit tests passed; CLI coverage reached 77.00% lines, 73.48% functions and 65.66% branches.

test_cases.name: Workflow and package regression
steps: Run the complete instrumented test suite.
Install the tarball in a consumer without worktree dependencies.
test_cases.expected_outcome: All workflows remain valid and the lifecycle runtime ships with dist/web.
test_cases.actual_result: 253 tests passed; isolated installation passed; npm pack contains 648 files, is 1.8 MB compressed and includes dist/composition/web-process-manager.js.

test_cases.name: Release health
steps: Run typecheck, lint, language and max-lines checks.
test_cases.expected_outcome: Quality thresholds pass, performance stays within budget and no unexempted vulnerability remains.
test_cases.actual_result: All static gates passed; benchmark completed in 199.59 ms against 5000 ms; npm audit reported no unexempted vulnerabilities.
